Current-source revalidation after a defect fix inside this task's accepted artifact. POST /iam/adult-gate derived an age from the request birth year and passed it to TrustedAgeEvidence, whose constructor rejects anything outside 0..150 with an unchecked exception; the boundary did not translate it, so an implausible birth year answered 500 iam.internal.error with retryable: true. The boundary now validates the derived age first and rejects with ADULT_AGE_EVIDENCE_INVALID and iam.adult_gate.birth_year_invalid, a non-retryable 403. Accepted behaviour for valid input is unchanged: 1995 and 2008 still return 200 PASSED and a 6-year-old still returns 403 adult_only. This entry is a behaviour change, not a digest-only rebase, and a reviewer of this accepted task should see it.

Current-source revalidation after the public site projection contract promotion. The canonical rule for /api/v1/public/site named admin-ops-service as its owner while the controller that serves the projection lives in content-service, so GatewayRouteExecutionPolicy withheld the route and the official site could not reach its own projection through the Gateway. The owner is now content-service and the projection is registered. This task only records the contract files, so nothing it accepted changed; its digests are rebound to the commit that carries the promotion.

Current-source revalidation after the P1R-M2-004 review rework. The rework moved config/p1r-data-ownership.v1.json, which corrects the Gateway Redis namespace to englishflow:gateway because the runtime keys, the ACL provisioning script and a live Redis denial all disagree with the previous value, and scripts/audit/p1r-data-ownership-check.mjs, whose assertion enforced that previous value. This task only records those files, so nothing it accepted changed; its digests are rebound to the commit that carries the rework.
